name: Croton Point
title: Hudson River Paddling Conditions Near Croton Point, NY

tide.label: NOAA 8518924 Haverstraw
tide.note: Tide from NOAA station 8518924 at Haverstraw, about four miles upriver.
tide.cardNote: Unless you plan on landing on a beach or poking into a shallow creek, tide is likely not very important to you.

current.label: NOAA HUR0401_11 Haverstraw
current.note: Current from NOAA station HUR0401_11 (Haverstraw), about three miles upriver, at the 4 ft bin nearest the surface. Flood and ebb headings are the river’s own axis at Croton Point.
